## Data Source: scalr_datadog_integration

Retrieves information about a Datadog integration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "scalr_datadog_integration" "example1" {
  id = "in-xxxxxxxxxx"
}

data "scalr_datadog_integration" "example2" {
  name = "datadog"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The identifier of the Datadog integration.
- `name` (String) The name of the Datadog integration.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) ID of the account the integration belongs to.
- `deployment_url` (String) URL of the Datadog site.
- `err_message` (String) Error message reported by Scalr when the integration is in the `failed` status.
- `status` (String) Status of the integration: `active`, `disabled` or `failed`.
